summary: Investigated the existing Composer component, the agent-session protocol layer, and the underlying pi-coding-agent types to understand how to add slash-command and skill invocation support to the composer. Established the project's design north star ('Quiet Workbench', 'Layered and restrained') and wrote DESIGN.md and apps/app/.impeccable/design.json to record those choices, then explored ResolvedCommand, SlashCommandInfo, PromptTemplate, and Skill types to plan a session.commands protocol.
decisions: Project visual design north star is 'Quiet Workbench' with 'Layered and restrained' depth.
Composer slash-command feature will surface commands from three sources (extension, prompt, skill) per the underlying SlashCommandSource union.
